[[File:WOTcalendarlogo.png|right|375px]]
Hello, and [[Wikipedia:Welcome, newcomers|welcome]] to '''A Wheel of Time Wiki'''!. Thanks for your edit to the [[:Aes Sedai]] page. I hope you like the place and decide to stay. Here are a few good links for newcomers:

By the way, please be sure to [[Help:Sign_your_posts_on_talk_pages|Sign your comments on talk pages]], using four tildes (&#126;&#126;&#126;&#126;) to produce your name and the current date, or three tildes (&#126;&#126;&#126;) for just your name. If you have any questions, please don't hesitate to contact [[:Category:Administrators|one of us]] for more information! -- [[User:Mainphramephreak|Mainphramephreak]] ([[User_talk:Mainphramephreak|Talk]]) 13:09, May 11, 2012

== Pounce badge ==

Hello. The Pounce badge is awarded when you edit one hundred pages within an hour of their creation. The wiki software keeps track of how many pages you do this on. As far as I know, there shouldn't be a "reset" or anything like that. Let me know if you have any other questions. ---- {{User:Mainphramephreak/Sig/Subst}} 02:09, August 20, 2012 (UTC)

== References ==

Just to let you know, the {{tl|ref}} and {{tl|ref/book}} templates surround the included info in the <nowiki><ref> and </ref></nowiki> tags. Adding them again breaks the {{tl|notes}} template. Please let me know if you have any questions. ---- {{User:Mainphramephreak/Sig/Subst}} 00:51, December 12, 2012 (UTC)

:Did you see how it breaks the text? I was trying to fix the formatting issue.
--[[User:Sings-With-Spirits|Sings-With-Spirits]] ([[User talk:Sings-With-Spirits|talk]]) 01:08, December 12, 2012 (UTC)

== Re: Ajah colors ==

I removed the manual categorization of the Ajahs. The [[:Template:Character|character template]] adds the category for the Ajah automatically. ---- {{User:Mainphramephreak/Sig/Subst}} 16:04, July 6, 2015 (UTC)

:It adds the category? I thought it just provided a link to its appropriate ajah article.
:Again, just curious.
:--[[User:Sings-With-Spirits|Sings-With-Spirits]] ([[User talk:Sings-With-Spirits|talk]]) 22:23, July 6, 2015 (UTC)

::Yup. Most of the entries on that template will automatically add a category based on the input. The entries will also change the color of the template as well. In fact, a large number of character pages won't need to have a manually added category; the template does the work for us. :) ---- {{User:Mainphramephreak/Sig/Subst}} 20:20, July 7, 2015 (UTC)
